## camera

- `camera-glide` (camera move, transition) The camera eases across from the last framing to the next, zooming and turning smoothly on the way. Takes image, video, svg. Presets: Natural blur, Swoop. Tags: camera, move, pan, zoom, ease, glide.
- `camera-whip-pan` (camera move, transition) The camera whips off the last framing toward the next in a streak of motion blur and whips in onto it, cutting at the blurriest moment. Takes image, video, svg. Presets: Soft, Hard. Tags: camera, move, whip, pan, swish, motion-blur, energetic.
- `camera-punch-zoom` (camera move, transition) The camera punches into the last framing, blurring every way, and cuts to the next one settling out of a punched-in view. Takes image, video, svg. Presets: Gentle, Slam. Tags: camera, move, zoom, punch, push-in, motion-blur, energetic.
- `camera-cut` (camera move, transition) The camera jumps straight to the next framing, taking no time. Takes image, video, svg. Tags: camera, cut, jump, instant.
- `camera-ken-burns` (camera move, hold) While the shot holds, the camera drifts slowly across the framing, easing from one zoom to another as it pans. Takes image, video, svg. Presets: Push in, Pull out, Slow drift. Tags: camera, hold, ken-burns, drift, documentary, slideshow, push-in.
- `camera-crash-zoom` (camera move, hold) While the shot holds, the camera crashes in on a point (a face, a stare, a detail) in a few sudden steps, each landing with a kick, and stays there. Takes image, video, svg. Presets: One crash, Slow dread, Extreme close-up. Tags: camera, hold, zoom, crash-zoom, dramatic, meme, shake.
- `camera-handheld` (camera move, hold) While the shot holds, the camera is held by hand: it drifts, sways and rolls a little around the framing, from a documentary's gentle float to found-footage shake, with footsteps if the operator walks. Takes image, video, svg. Presets: Subtle, Walking, Shaky cam, Found footage. Tags: camera, hold, handheld, shake, wobble, documentary, found-footage, cinematic.
